summary: Stops NullAway from reading javac's mutable WildcardType.bound by computing effective upper bounds for type arguments via fresh capture conversion, and preserves inferred nullness on captures through generic method inference.

tests.evidence: Bug fix owes regressions: adds TypeInspectionChecker-based BytecodeGenericsTests, dependent-bound and inferred-capture WildcardTests, and updates a Spring-derived expectation; reviewers asked for a regression with an already-captured RHS.

doc_comments.evidence: Non-obvious GenericsUtils logic; lazaroclapp approved but said he could not follow what the method arguments refer to from the Javadoc, and the author later deleted the case and added 'clarify javadoc'/'improve comment' commits.

change_description.evidence: Description explains cause, approach, gating and leftover work (#1850).

performance.evidence: visitClassType now runs capture conversion for both sides on every generic compatibility check when HandleWildcardGenerics is on; flag-gated, but a hot path worth a glance.

backward_compat.evidence: Changes diagnostics under HandleWildcardGenerics only (removes false positives, a Spring-derived test now errors earlier).

correctness.evidence: CodeRabbit found (and msridhar confirmed 'This issue is valid') that an existing CapturedType RHS still went through wildcardUpperBound on the mutable backing wildcard, reintroducing the stale-bound false positive; lazaroclapp also found redundant formalTypeVariable null checks.

surprising_behavior.evidence: GenericMethodTests expectation moved to a different diagnostic location; flag-gated.

contradictions.evidence: Javadoc of visitClassType/wildcardContains rewritten with the new parameters; a glance that they match the new bound flow.

build_ci.evidence: Adds a fixture class to test-java-lib for separately compiled generics; no build script change.

spec_conformance.evidence: Rewrites JLS 4.5.1 wildcard containment and relies on capture conversion (JLS 5.1.10) and JSpecify implicit-bound nullness.

plan.why: A large type-system change: one reviewer traces capture and containment logic against the JLS with the tests, a second reads the Javadoc cold to check it explains the terminology.
